marketing.title: Penetration Tests
marketing.description: Continuous black-box testing of your applications and APIs. Findings ship with validated exploits, blast-radius, and remediation that maps to SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
marketing.paragraph1: Twenty-two autonomous agents test your surface like an experienced attacker — concurrently. A typical scan completes in one to three hours and surfaces validated findings with proof.
marketing.paragraph2: Scans run on push, on schedule, or on demand. You don't need to staff a security team to run them.
marketing.previewAnnotation: Preview · your workspace, after a few scans
marketing.howItWorksNote: Three steps from connect to attestation.
marketing.step1Description: Point us at a staging URL, production host, or VPN-bound endpoint. Optionally link a GitHub repo for source-aware testing.
marketing.step2Description: Specialist agents probe injection, auth, access, headers, crypto, and logic flaws concurrently. Scans run in 1–3 hours.
marketing.step3Description: Every finding ships with an exploit PoC, blast-radius analysis, and step-by-step remediation mapped to your frameworks.
marketing.whatGetsTestedNote: OWASP Top 10 plus the categories your auditor will ask about.
marketing.whatFindingLooksLikeNote: From a real scan — every detail is what you'd ship to an auditor.
marketing.whatYouTakeAwayNote: A 33-page report your auditor can read end-to-end.

riskMethodology.approachHelper: How risks are identified and assessed (default: asset-based, inherent + residual).
riskMethodology.responsibilitiesHelper: What every named risk owner is accountable for, including residual-risk acceptance.
riskMethodology.frequencyHelper: How often risks are reviewed (default: quarterly review, annual formal reassessment).
riskMethodology.documentationHelper: Where risks, treatments, and acceptance events are held and which documents derive from them.
riskMethodology.likelihoodHelper: What each of the five likelihood levels means for your organization.
riskMethodology.impactHelper: What each of the five impact levels means for your organization.
riskMethodology.thresholdsHelper: The acceptance requirement each risk level triggers (default: low levels accepted, medium with owner sign-off, high levels must be treated).
riskMethodology.treatmentHelper: What each treatment strategy means. The labels match the Risks module's strategies with their ISO 27001 option names.
